gaps.term: Gate behaviour in a linear network (cited claim)
gaps.quote: A gate is a fixed linear map applied to the values on the wires it touches, and it changes only those wires.
gaps.note: The page gives this as a cited claim about how a gate, the page's own concept, works, but does not say which source states it or why it holds. The reader cannot check that a gate changes only the wires it touches from what the page gives.
